english.title: Wilfully insult a magistrate during sitting or going to / returning from court
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) wilfully insulted **(..SPECIFY THE JUSTICE OR JUSTICES..) sitting in the **(..SPECIFY THE MAGISTRATES' COURT AND LOCATION..) during

(A)_[his]_
(B)_[her]_
(C)_[their]_

(D)_[sitting in]_
(E)_[going to]_
(F)_[returning from]_

the said court
english.legislation: Contrary to section 12(1)(a) and (2) of the Contempt of Court Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
wilfully insulted a magistrate/magistrates sitting in a specific court and place
during his/her/their sitting/going to court/ returning from court

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 12(4) of the Contempt of Court Act 1981 provides that a magistrates' court may at any time revoke an order of committal to prison made under section 12(2) and, if the offender is in custody, order his discharge.

other.powersofarrest: Arrest on order of the Court
other.penalty:
One Months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding £2,500.

Time limit on prosecutions:-
None
